m: एमूष m. (formed fr. the above) N. of the boar which raised up the earth, ŚBr. xiv, 1, 2, 11; Kāṭh.

v: tri॰ iRa--karmmaRi ma । 1 prApye । “arTaSca ma emaSca” yaju॰ 18, 15, “emaH prAptavyArTaH” vedadI॰ ।
m: एम, अम्, एमन्, अ, n. course, way, RV.; VS.; [cf. Gk. οἶμος, οἴμη; Lith. eisme.]
a: एम — a. To be obtained. --मः, एमन् n. Ved. A course, way.

v: na॰ etyanena mArgeRa iRa--karaRe manin । 1 gatimArge “kfzRaM ta ema ruSataH” f॰ 4, 7, 9 । “kfzRaM ta ema ruSadUrme 1, 58, 4 । “emanSabdena gamanamArga ucyate” BA॰ etyatra ADAre manin । 2 avasTitisTAne । “pfzWe samudrasyeman” yaju॰ 13, 17, “eman avasTAne” vedadI॰ । “apAM tvemantsAdayAmi” 13, 53 । saptamyA luki na nalopaH । BAve manin । 3 gamane । “dUre dfSo ye citayanta emaBiH” f॰ 5, 59, 2 emaBirgamanEH” BA॰ ।

m: एमुषम् (acc. sg. of the perf. p. of 3. अम्, p. 80, col. 1).
